title: observability: token-level tracing, metrics, dashboards, and alert tuning
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Customers and SRE saw noisy alerts and unclear cost/latency attribution at the token level for our streaming endpoints. This PR adds token-level metrics and tracing spans, upgrades dashboards to visualize cost/latency per-token and per-route, and tunes several alerts to reduce noise while preserving SLO guardrails. Summary of changes: 1) Metrics: added redwood.tokens.processed, redwood.tokens.latency_ms (histogram), redwood.tokens.cost_usd (gauge), and per-route labels (route, model, customer_tier). Updated metric naming to follow telemetry style guide. 2) Tracing: emit finer-grained spans for tokenization, model forward, kv-cache lookup and streaming flush; added span attributes token_count and prefix_cache_hit. Sampling default adjusted to 5% for high-volume routes, and 100% for suspected regression routes (configurable). 3) Dashboards: new Token Cost & Latency dashboard (Observability -> Dashboards) with widgets for p50/p95/p99 token latency, cost-by-route, and heatmap of kv-cache hit ratio. Consolidated previous token dashboards and added example queries. 4) Alerting: tuned existing alerts: TOKEN_PROCESSING_ERROR_RATE (reworked to use rolling 5m error budget and route-level grouping), TOKEN_LATENCY_P99_HIGH (raised threshold for dedicated customers and added cooldown), and TOKEN_COST_SPIKE (switched to anomaly detection with historical baseline). 5) Tests and e2e: added unit tests for metric tagging and an integration test that verifies spans are emitted end-to-end for a short streaming session. Included migration guide and rollout plan. Rollout: staged rollout behind feature flag; telemetry joins as opt-in for internal tenants for 48h then global rollout. Backwards compatibility: metric names are additive; no breaking changes to API. Monitoring and alert remediation: updated runbook and dashboard links in alert descriptions. Additional notes: removed a noisy legacy tag (token.latency.percentile) and updated docs in /redwood-docs/docs/observability/token-level.md.
